title: Structured output docs refresh: JSON schema examples, validation, retries + FAQ
author: Wei Chen
release_notes: Docs: refreshed Structured Output guidance with JSON Schema examples, validation + retry patterns, clarified error semantics, and added a short FAQ. Legacy JSON-mode snippets removed/redirected to canonical examples.
body:
## Summary
This PR refreshes the Structured Output docs to match the current Hosted API behavior and the canonical example patterns we’re standardizing across SDKs (Python/TS/Go). The old page mixed “JSON mode” language and implied that models always return valid JSON. It also didn’t address common failure modes we see in support (schema mismatch, silent parse failures, users validating only after tool execution).

Changes in this PR:
- Rewrites the Structured Output page to center on **JSON Schema-based structured output** (and positions “JSON mode” as legacy/ambiguous terminology).
- Adds copy/pasteable examples for:
  - A minimal JSON Schema (with required fields) and an explanation of the strictness tradeoffs.
  - **Validate-then-use** pattern (do not act on unvalidated fields).
  - A recommended **retry strategy** (retry on parse/validation failures with a capped attempt count and backoff).
- Adds a dedicated **Errors & troubleshooting** section with clear guidance on how to interpret:
  - schema mismatch / validation failures
  - model output that is JSON but not schema-conformant
  - partial JSON from streaming (and why structured output should be consumed from the final response object)
- Adds a short **FAQ** addressing recurring questions from support and sales (e.g., “Is it guaranteed?”, “Can I stream structured output?”, “Should I loosen the schema?”).
- Updates cross-links to point to the canonical examples repo and removes legacy snippets that had drifted.

## Motivation / context
Support ticket SUP-18433 and recent DevEx audit work identified that customers copying older docs were hitting schema mismatch errors and/or implementing unsafe parsing patterns. Product also requested that we align terminology across docs (PM-612) and match the gateway semantics landing in the platform (ENG-2842).

## What changed (high level)
- New narrative structure:
  1) What structured output is (and isn’t)
  2) JSON Schema guidelines (do/don’t)
  3) Validation & retries
  4) Error semantics + troubleshooting
  5) FAQ
- Added explicit warnings:
  - Don’t execute side effects based on unvalidated model output
  - Don’t log raw tool args / structured payloads that may contain sensitive data
  - Avoid over-permissive schemas unless you have a strong reason

## Files / areas touched
- docs/hosted-api/structured-output.mdx (rewrite)
- docs/hosted-api/structured-output-faq.mdx (new)
- docs/partials/warnings/validate-before-use.mdx (new partial)
- docs/partials/snippets/structured-output-schema-minimal.(md|mdx) (new)
- docs/partials/snippets/structured-output-retry-pattern.(md|mdx) (new)
- docs/navigation/hosted-api-sidebar.json (link/name tweaks)
- docs/redirects.json (redirect legacy /json-mode to /structured-output)
- docs/glossary.mdx (terminology: “tool calling” + “structured output”)

## Example content (representative excerpt)
The page now includes a concrete schema example and validation guidance:

"""json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "summary": { "type": "string" },
    "risk_level": { "type": "string", "enum": ["low", "medium", "high"] },
    "recommendations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string" },
      "minItems": 1
    }
  },
  "required": ["summary", "risk_level", "recommendations"]
}
"""

And a recommended retry rule-of-thumb:
- Retry up to 2 times for parse/validation failures
- On retry, restate the schema constraints and include the validation error message
- Do not “auto-fix” by heuristically patching JSON unless you also re-validate

## How to test
- Local:
  - `pnpm lint`
  - `pnpm test:docs`
  - `pnpm dev` and verify the Structured Output page renders correctly and the new partials resolve
- Sanity:
  - Validate redirects from `/json-mode` and any legacy anchors
  - Confirm links to canonical examples resolve

## Checklist
- [x] Terminology aligned with PM-612 (structured output vs JSON mode)
- [x] Snippets use consistent naming and are copy/pasteable
- [x] Includes explicit warnings about unsafe patterns
- [x] Added a short FAQ for common customer questions

## Review conversation (highlights)
Elliot Price: Can we make the retry guidance less prescriptive? Some teams won’t want retries in docs.
Wei Chen (author): Agreed — I adjusted language to “recommended pattern” and added a note that retries should be gated by idempotency + latency budgets.

Henry Cho: Please ensure we don’t imply that strict schemas are always best — some customers will need backward-compatible extensions.
Wei Chen (author): Added a section under schema guidelines: when to use `additionalProperties: true` and how to version schemas. Also linked to the internal standards doc in a non-public “Further reading for advanced users” callout.

Brian Murphy: Error semantics section should reference the gateway behavior: validation errors are returned as structured errors; model output may still be present but should not be trusted.
Wei Chen (author): Updated the “Errors” section to explicitly say: treat the request as failed on schema mismatch and do not consume partial payloads; added a short note about checking the final response object.

Marcus Lin: Can we add an explicit warning about executing tools / side effects based on unvalidated structured output?
Wei Chen (author): Added a warning partial (“Validate before use”) and placed it above the first example.

Ibrahim Khan: Please avoid showing streaming structured output as a supported approach; it’ll lead to partial JSON parsing in customer code.
Wei Chen (author): FAQ now answers: “Can I stream structured output?” — guidance says stream tokens for UX, but only parse structured output from the final response.

## CI
- Initial run: ❌ link-check failed (broken anchor to canonical examples README)
- Fix: updated link to the stable path + added redirect entry
- Final: ✅ lint / typecheck / link-check / build passed

## Merge notes
Squash merge. No behavior changes; documentation only. Follow-up PR(s) will update adjacent pages to reference this canonical section where they currently embed schema snippets (tracked in ENG-2846).
